rows.text: I’ll inspect the implementation and its package context, then make the smallest fix in `dedupe/dedupe.go`.

rows.input:

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('dedupe/dedupe.go')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('seen := map[string]bool{}', 'seen := make(map[string]bool)')
s = s.replace('''		if seen[v] {
			seen[v] = false
			continue
		}
		seen[v] = true''', '''		if seen[v] {
			continue
		}
		seen[v] = true''')
p.write_text(s)
PY
